page_title: BOC 2-0 DOR | Bochum v Dortmund 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Harm Osmers has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+4' Julien Duranville (Dortmund) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Dortmund are going to take it.
90+2' Yan Couto (Dortmund) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Anthony Losilla (Bochum) will replace Tom Krauss.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
88' Dieter Hecking has decided to substitute Philipp Hofmann and he is replaced by Dani de Wit (Bochum).
88' Here's the change. Georgios Masouras leaves the pitch and Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) comes on as a substitute.
86' The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick. Tom Krauss (Bochum) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.
84' A dangerous looking corner kick from Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) is cleared to safety by the defence.
84' Dortmund get a corner. Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
83' The resulting corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
82' Yan Couto (Dortmund) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Dortmund can continue in their attacking effort.
81' That's unlucky! Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
80' It will be a substitution. Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) is ready to enter the pitch as Pascal Gross walks off.

78' What a chance that is! Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
77' Dortmund are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
74' It's time for a substitution. Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) comes on in place of Gerrit Holtmann.
73' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes the corner but it's cleared.
73' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
73' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
73' Julien Duranville (Dortmund) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Good work from Dortmund as they win a corner.
71' Bochum showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.

69' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Gregor Kobel makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner.
67' Gregor Kobel displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Georgios Masouras (Bochum) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.

66' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
66' An attempted cross from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is cleared.
63' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Julien Duranville (Dortmund) replacing Karim Adeyemi.
63' Substitution. Yan Couto (Dortmund) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Niklas Sule walks off.

63' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.

61' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Gregor Kobel makes a great save to stop the effort going into the left side of the goal.
60' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is behind the touchline and Dortmund will take a throw-in.
58' Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Jamie Gittens is replaced by Maximilian Beier (Dortmund).
56' Wonderful movement by Bochum. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

54' What a great effort! Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
52' A pass into the box finds Julian Brandt (Dortmund) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Timo Horn denies him.
51' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
49' Bernardo (Bochum) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.

47' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
46' Here is a change. Marcel Sabitzer is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Salih Ozcan (Dortmund).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

45' A dangerous towering header by Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
45' Emre Can (Dortmund) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
45' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Dortmund will have a corner.
43' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he sends his effort over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.

40' Dortmund slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

35' 2 - 0 Goal! The ball breaks to Georgios Masouras (Bochum) after some poor defending, he finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and calmly puts the ball into the back of the net! He makes it 2:0.

33' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Philipp Hofmann, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Georgios Masouras (Bochum), who beats Gregor Kobel with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
31' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) whips in a cross from the corner, but Timo Horn is well positioned and punches the ball away.
31' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Dortmund force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
29' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
28' Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul after Matus Bero (Bochum) hacks down one of his opponents. Dortmund have a free kick.
28' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Dortmund will take a throw-in.

26' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
26' Matus Bero (Bochum) steps up to send the ball in.

26' Matus Bero (Bochum) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger. The referee points to the corner flag and Bochum will take a corner.

25' The game is interrupted. Emre Can (Dortmund) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Free kick. Bochum will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
24' Tim Oermann (Bochum) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Harm Osmers blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

19' Matus Bero (Bochum) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
18' Timo Horn displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
18' Dortmund seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

15' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bochum will have a goal kick.
15' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jamie Gittens (Dortmund), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
13' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) is caught offside!
11' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

11' Great solo effort by Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save. Now Dortmund have a corner.

9' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Gregor Kobel shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
7' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.

5' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. It's a free kick to Dortmund, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

4' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Georgios Masouras (Bochum) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Gregor Kobel pulls off an easy save.
2' Dortmund can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

1' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball is out of play and Bochum manage to earn a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
Dortmund will kick-off.
Harm Osmers is introduced as the referee for today's match.
